contract_facts_part_b.basis: Module docstrings of website/climate.py, website/snowgrid.py and website/stations.py (the three modules part B reads first), with gauges.py and joins.py included because the site reads them too.

climate.source: NOAA nClimGrid-Daily, bucket noaa-nclimgrid-daily-pds, ncdd-YYYYMM-grd-scaled.nc (prelim files only where no scaled file exists); variables prcp (mm), tmax and tmin (C); 596 x 1385 grid at 1/24 degree; file attribute 'license = no restrictions'; registry text quoted in the docstring; the page says 'US government data; NOAA declares no restrictions; attribution requested' and must not say public domain for these grids unless the owner accepts that basis.
climate.cell_rule: Half-open: lat in (south, north], lon in [west, east) in 1/48 degree units (centres 1179 + 2i and -5985 + 2j); same as hail.cell_for in exact decimal arithmetic.
climate.mask: 25,973 Montana centre cells; 25,902 land; 71 water ('No land value for this grid cell').
climate.missing: NaN, -999.99 and values outside valid_min/valid_max are missing, never summed or zero; a day with a missing input for a cell is a missing day.
climate.rounding_thresholds: Each daily value rounded to 0.01, then tenths of C (half up). F tenths = round half up (1.8 x tenths C + 320). 90 F day: tmax at least 322 tenths C. Freeze-thaw: tmax above 0 C and tmin below 0 C. Low below 32 F: tmin below 0 C. At or below 0 F: tmin at or below -178 tenths C.
climate.periods: Seasons July to June (2021-22 to 2025-26, partial 2026-27); calendar years 2021 to 2026; water years 2021 to 2027. Each period is 13 integers: [days, missing, rain hundredths of an inch, largest one-day rain hundredths, its date yyyymmdd, highest tenths F, its date, lowest tenths F, its date, days at or above 90 F, days at or below 0 F, freeze-thaw days, days with a low below 32 F]; null where no day has a value.
climate.store: hail/c/rRRRR_cCCCC.json per B1 tile, format hail-climate-v1: {f (five seasons together), r, c, state (sorted in-tile keys), cells {key: {i, j, f, s, c, w}}}. Water cells appear in state only.
climate.units_words: Inches (two decimals), degrees F (one decimal), days (whole), dates as 'Jun 15, 2025'. Kind word on every row: 'Grid estimate'. Timing: scaled months appear 4 to 68 days after month end; prelim days 2 to 3 days behind; ETags compared each run.
climate.failure: Each request retried; failures recorded (listing, month, reason). Failed listing: part unavailable. Failed or missing month: partial with the month named. No months loaded: unavailable.

snowgrid.source: NOHRSC National Snow Analysis, sfav2_CONUS_<Y>093012_to_<Y+1>093012.tif, one per water year: 2022 to 2026 present (11,562,084 B); 2020-21 missing upstream (HTTP 404). Terms: the NWS public-domain paragraph quoted in TERMS_NOTE (three conditions) and the 17 U.S.C. 403 sentence; the NWS name and identifier are trademark protected; a site may not present its own information as official.
snowgrid.grid: 1500 x 850 float32, 0.04 degree, PixelIsArea, WGS 84, origin -126.0 E, 55.0 N; no data below -9000; Montana box rows 150 to 265, columns 248 to 548 (34,916 cells).
snowgrid.units: Units are not printed in the file. D7 decides: slope from 0.85 to 1.15 against station season totals in inches means inches. Currently fails (slope 0.664), so no values are shown. Words: 'Analysis: not shown ...' (unit_failed) and 'Analysis: {inches} in of snow in the {water_year} water year, from the analysis cell about {miles} miles away. An analysis, not a measurement at this address.'
snowgrid.cell_rule: row = floor((55.0 - lat) / 0.04), col = floor((lon + 126.0) / 0.04) in exact decimal thousandths; an edge point goes to the cell south or east. Benchland (47.08, -110.02) is row 198, column 399.
snowgrid.store: hail/n/<tile>.json format hail-snow-v1, five water years per cell, integers in hundredths of an inch, floor(value x 100 + 0.5), null for missing or negative; written only when D7 passes. Index block 'snow' carries the check, samples, files and terms.
snowgrid.cli: python -m website.snowgrid build|verify --store DIR --cache DIR [--offline] [--deadline-at EPOCH]

stations.source: GHCN-Daily from NCEI: ghcnd-stations.txt, ghcnd-inventory.txt, all/<ID>.dly (the NCEI copy, not the stale S3 copy). Elements TMAX, TMIN (tenths C), PRCP (tenths mm), SNOW and SNWD (mm); -9999 missing; a non-blank Q-flag excludes a value; trace (T) counts as zero in sums and is said so.
stations.timing: Archive values replace real-time values about 45 to 60 days after month end; the newest report date is shown.
stations.licence: NOAA and federal records: public domain in the United States under NCEI-PD-10-2-02 section 4(a); CoCoRaHS (US1 prefix) under CC BY 3.0 with attribution; the NODD copy is CC0. Cite NCEI-PD-10-2-02.
stations.rule: Candidates within 40 miles with an unflagged value in the last 30 days; coverage over 2,192 days (2020-01-01 to 2025-12-31) at least 80 percent per element; the two nearest that pass; fewer than two: show those that pass and say so; none: 'No station within 40 miles has enough reports for {element} from 2020 to 2025.' Season or calendar values show only at 95 percent of days, and every station's share is shown.
stations.thresholds: 90 F = TMAX 322 tenths C or more; 1 inch of snow depth = SNWD 25 mm or more (not 25.4). Freeze-thaw and low-below-32-F rules as for climate.
stations.words: 'Station reading: {inches} in of snow in the {season} season at {station}, {miles} miles away ({k} of {d} days with a value).' Every station row names the station, its distance and kind word; 'Data unavailable' carries the reason.
stations.store: hail/sd/<id>.json format hail-stn-v1 per station: name, position, newest unflagged date per element, coverage counts 2020 to 2025, and per period (July to June, calendar, water years 2022 to 2026, Oct to Sep) per element: rep, ok, trace, sum, max/max_d/max_n or min/min_d/min_n, ge90, lt32, ge1, FT and DL day pairs. Dates yyyymmdd. Tile centres: lat 54.950 - 0.1 x row, lon -129.950 + 0.1 x col.
stations.cli: python -m website.stations build [--procs 4] [--offline] [--refresh all|none] [--refresh-ids FILE] [--deadline-at EPOCH]; rule-ids; verify

gauges.source: NWPS list and detail (api.water.noaa.gov/nwps/v1) for flood categories in feet; USGS peaks (api.waterdata.usgs.gov, parameter_code 00065, required) for annual peak stage by water year. Credit: 'Observations courtesy of U.S. Geological Survey.' NWS conditions apply to NWPS pages.
gauges.rule: Nearest pool gauge within 10 miles (owner decision O4; 25 miles is the alternative). Pool: every gauge in the box that defines an NWS flood stage (minor category), excluding gauges whose categories are elevations of 1,000 ft or more (Lake Pend Oreille at Hope, 13.7 miles). A listed gauge whose detail failed is a candidate by position: 'could not be loaded', never 'none'.
gauges.store: hail/g/<usgs>.json format hail-gauge-v1: name, position, stages in hundredths of a foot, LIDs sharing the number, peaks rows [water year, date, hundredths, qualifiers]. Scope 104 files (103 with peaks).
gauges.words: 'River flood record at the {name} gauge, {miles} miles away; it does not say water reached this address.' No daily flood-day counts.

joins.sources: IEM watchwarn, LSR and daily summaries (public domain; attribution requested; no warranty of accuracy); NWS public-domain terms; NCEI Storm Events (BEGIN times MST-7 on Montana rows); NCEI SWDI nx3hail; Census TIGER/Line 2026 counties (not copyrighted; trademarks; acknowledgement to the U.S. Census Bureau required).
joins.window: SPC report days 12:00 UTC to 12:00 UTC: store window 2021-10-17 12:00 UTC to 2026-10-17 12:00 UTC (research window 2021-10-19 to 2026-10-19 counted separately).
joins.units: LSR hail, rain, snow in inches; LSR gusts and sustained wind in mph; magnitudes shown only for codes H, R, S (inches) and G, N, A (mph); codes 5, 6, 7, I, J show no magnitude and show the remark as written (unit unverified). NCEI wind in knots with mph beside. SWDI MAXSIZE stored as hundredths of an inch. Station gust days: whole knots and whole mph; 50 kt (58 mph) or more is a day; 130 kt or more is dropped; flagged for check per D12.
joins.polygon_cover: A polygon covers a cell when it intersects the cell's square (D11); the centre rule is counted beside it. A town point is tested by exact point-in-polygon. Outline-less polygons join by county or zone code or are counted; never read as no warning.
joins.zone_periods: D8: CAN, UPG or EXP closes a period; a later NEW, CON, EXT, EXA or EXB opens the next; each period is a span with begin and end (cancelled at, upgraded, end not recorded).
joins.store: hail/j/events.json (hail-events-v2: every report, record and warning once); hail/j/r{tr:04d}_c{tc:04d}.json per B1 tile (reports and records as indexes; warnings as [index, 100-bit cover]; zones, fire zones, counties as cell-key lists; two nearest stations); hail/z/MTZ###.json and z/fire-MTZ###.json; hail/k/MTC###.json (county-only FA.A and FF.A and outline-less polygons); hail/s/<id>.json (gust days as [day index, mph, kt, flag]); index joins block; manifest.
joins.kind_words: Report; Record (NCEI); Warning (NWS polygon, relayed by IEM); Zone product; Station reading; Data unavailable. Damage threat tag shown as the NWS's own label.
joins.requests: Each IEM watchwarn request runs 1 December of the prior year to 31 January of the next; offline builds make no request; the re-pull window is fetched fresh and cached copies are used only if that fails.
joins.cli: python -m website.joins build --store DIR --cache DIR [--procs 4] [--today YYYY-MM-DD] [--offline]; verify STORE [--cache]; compare STORE; fixture

Crystal Lake (SNOTEL in the GHCN copy) is used for SNWD; the code does not fetch NRCS or AWDB. Counsel should confirm that the held SNOTEL item covers the direct NRCS service, not the GHCN copy used by gate B5-3.
